dialect.detail: Uses GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL with htmlpp preprocessor extension ($set preprocess(htmlpp)), free source format directive, EXEC HTML blocks for CGI web output, and 'identified by' clause for CGI form fields. Likely part of a Brazilian ERP/fiscal system (ICMS tax management).

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian state tax (ICMS Substituto) rate management - listing and navigation of ICMS substitute tax rates by origin/destination state (UF) and product subtype, with validity date ranges
purpose.summary: This program manages the listing and pagination of ICMS Substituto (substitute ICMS tax) rates for Brazilian state tax purposes. It handles CGI web form input, supports next/previous page navigation and 'go to' functionality, and renders HTML output showing tax rates by origin UF, destination UF, product subtype, and validity period. It is part of a larger Brazilian fiscal/ERP web application.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for CGI/web output)
'identified by' clause for CGI form field binding
Multiple COPY statements (12) for shared file/record definitions
Inline JavaScript within EXEC HTML for UF dropdown lists
Brazilian state (UF) dropdown lists embedded in COBOL
